Reviews.name: Ayomikun Ayobami .
Reviews.description: Being part of the AWS Cloud Club, University of Ilorin, gave me a solid foundation in AWS cloud fundamentals. Through the club’s mentorship and bootcamp sessions, I gained valuable knowledge and hands on experience. I was also fortunate to receive an AWS certification voucher, which helped me take my first step toward building a successful career in the cloud industry.

Reviews.description: Joining this club changed how I see tech. I got my first AWS cert and internship through the community!
